Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve - we care. What you do at McKesson matters. Program Overview McKesson's Intern program is designed to provide: • A real-life working environment • A solid foundation of experience and hopeful offer of full-time employment • A cohort experience with other interns Consistent senior leadership exposure and learning experiences. • We are looking for candidates who have: • Willingness to learn, develop, and contribute to a fun, demanding, fast-paced environment. • Self-starter that brings both interpersonal skills abilities to identify a problem then solve it. Passion and enthusiasm for healthcare and our customers' success • Work Term: Summer 2026- May 4th through August 28th Location: Mississauga, ON, CAN - 2300 Meadowvale Blvd (Hybrid) Job Responsibilities: The Corporate Strategy & Business Development Intern will support and lead several pivotal strategic engagements at McKesson Canada, including, but not limited to: • • Qualitative and quantitative research Market landscape, trends, and dynamics • Consumer preferences, prices, marketing preferences, and distribution patterns • Competitive intelligence, strategies, and threats • Data-gathering and analysis • Measurement of outcomes and effectiveness of programs and strategies • Monitoring and forecasting of sales and marketing trends • Insight communication and recommendations • Clearly articulated reports and presentations Simple and reader-friendly charts, graphs, and visual aids • We are proud to offer a competitive compensation package at McKesson as part of our Total Rewards. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. The pay range shown below is aligned with McKesson's pay philosophy, and pay will always be compliant with any applicable regulations. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long-term incentive opportunities may be offered. For more information regarding benefits at McKesson, please click here. Our Base Pay Range for this position $17.69 - $27.74 Job Requirements Qualifications: Work experience: 1-3 years of prior experience in fields related to market research and data analytics. Skills that are most likely to drive success in the role: • • Analytical thinking Detail-oriented approach to qualitative and quantitative research methodologies • Ability to comprehend and interpret competitor strategies and consumer behavior • Ability to gather, clean, analyze and interpret large volumes of data • Ability to manage multiple priorities • Strong organizational skills • Ability to work under pressure and meet strict deadlines • Strong communication skills • Ability to communicate across written and verbal formats • Ability to simplify complex information into a reader-friendly format • Proficient in the Microsoft Office Suite • Intermediate / advanced Excel skills • Intermediate PowerPoint skills Basic understanding of databases and statistical packages • Education Bachelor's degree in a related field, including but not limited to, STEM, statistics, finance, business, market research, etc. • Physical Requirements • Role is based in the Mississauga office, following a hybrid, 'Office as a Destination' approach with 2 days/week in office Occasional travel (~10%). • Citizenship Requirement N/A APPLICATION INFORMATION Application Procedure Through Employer Website Special Application Instructions Application Link: https://careers.mckesson.com/en/job/mississauga/corporate-strategy-and-business-development-intern-summer- 2026/733/92133790784 Please click the "I intend to apply to this position" button on SCOPE and also submit your application via the employer's website.
